testCases.notes: Known-bug note (form submits without name) no longer applicable — 'This field is required' shown, form blocked. Bug fixed in Theme 2.51.0-pr-2315.
Invalid months 13, 00, 99 all rejected — red border on expiry field, Place Order disabled for each.
2-digit CVV '12' blocked (Place Order disabled). 5-digit input capped at 3 by iframe — 4th/5th digit rejected, valid 3-digit result accepted.
Empty CVV blocks Place Order (button disabled).
Non-numeric chars ('abc') filtered silently — Place Order disabled. Mixed '8a8' → '88' stored (letter dropped), 2-digit result blocks Place Order.
Card number displays as '4622 9431 2701 3705' — space-separated 4-digit groups confirmed in DOM snapshot.
Visa card type detected after BIN entry (card starting '4' → Visa icon highlighted in card type selector).

CVV field renders plaintext in CyberSource Flex Microform iframe — masking is processor-controlled (CyberSource default). Security isolation maintained via cross-origin iframe; not a storefront defect.
Card number field confirmed inside cross-origin iframe (DOM ref=e835, frame prefix f8). Parent page has no DOM access to card number input — same-origin policy enforced.
CVV field confirmed inside separate cross-origin iframe (DOM ref=e836, frame prefix f9). Parent page has no DOM access to CVV input.
Network requests show only /graphql calls to storefront origin. No raw card data in any network request. Tokenization handled inside CyberSource iframe before token is passed to storefront.
By architectural guarantee: card data captured inside cross-origin CyberSource iframe; storefront domain cannot access or store raw card data in localStorage/sessionStorage.
Cart page served over HTTPS — https://vcst-qa-storefront.govirto.com/cart confirmed in browser URL throughout session.

CyberSource Flex Microform loaded successfully with JWT — form functional throughout session confirming valid JWT in iframe src. Token is session-specific (generated server-side per session by vc-module-cybersource).
